config_version.description: Configuration contract version; change only with an intentional schema revision.

reward_mode.description: Selects handcrafted environment rewards or a reward model fitted from synthetic preferences; it changes the training reward source.

objective.description: Fixed task preference: success outranks failure, shorter successful attempts rank higher, and failed attempts tie.

seed.description: Controls seeded policy initialization and environment sampling; changing it produces a different stochastic run.

device_name.description: Selects tensor execution on auto, CPU, or CUDA; hardware affects runtime and can affect numerical results.

grid_size.description: Sets cells along each grid side; larger grids increase travel distances and usually make coordination harder.

num_agents.description: Sets cooperating agents sharing one policy; more agents add joint state/action complexity.

num_actions.description: Fixed at five: up, down, left, right, and stay.

max_steps.description: Maximum environment transitions per episode; preference fitting also requires enough successful lengths for its holdout stride.

hidden_size.description: Sets neurons per actor/critic hidden layer; larger networks can represent more complex policies but use more compute and may need more data.

actor_lr.description: Adam actor learning rate; larger values make policy changes more aggressive and can destabilize learning.

critic_lr.description: Adam critic learning rate; larger values change value estimates faster and can destabilize advantage estimates.

gamma.description: Discount per environment step; larger values give later rewards more weight. Preference-learned mode requires 1.0 so trajectory returns are undiscounted.

gae_lambda.description: GAE trace decay; larger values include more distant TD residuals and reduce bias while often increasing variance.

clip_epsilon.description: PPO probability-ratio clipping half-width; larger values allow more change before clipping removes the incentive, without bounding actual policy changes.

update_epochs.description: PPO passes over a collected rollout; more passes reuse data more but can overfit it or move policy too far.

minibatch_size.description: Maximum samples per optimizer step; larger slices mean fewer, usually less noisy gradient steps per epoch.

entropy_coef.description: Weight of policy entropy bonus; increasing it favors exploration and can slow convergence to a decisive policy.

value_coef.description: Scales critic squared-error loss and gradients only; actor and critic have separate optimizers. With Adam this does not directly scale the effective learning rate.

total_episodes.description: Training episodes; more episodes provide more experience and require more runtime, without guaranteeing improvement.

progress_window.description: Episodes in trailing report averages; larger windows smooth short-term variation but react more slowly.

output_directory.description: Report root; absolute paths are used directly and relative paths resolve from the project root.

goal_reward.description: Handcrafted reward bonus per agent reaching the target; increasing it makes success more valuable relative to penalties.

distance_penalty.description: Handcrafted penalty per cell of target distance; increasing it favors movement toward the target more strongly.

step_penalty.description: Handcrafted penalty per environment transition; increasing it favors shorter episodes, including in unsuccessful attempts.

preference_epochs.description: Optimization passes when fitting the preference reward model; more passes cost more compute and may overfit.

preference_lr.description: Preference reward model optimizer learning rate; larger values fit faster but can overshoot or destabilize fitting.

preference_weight_decay.description: L2 penalty on preference model weights; increasing it regularizes the fit more strongly.

preference_holdout_stride.description: Every nth successful length is held out; smaller strides reserve more lengths for validation and fewer for fitting. Failure remains a baseline partner.

show_plots.description: Whether to display training figures; false skips the interactive plot display.

visualize_policy.description: Whether to run policy demonstrations; false skips their rendering.

visualization_episodes.description: Number of demonstration episodes when visualization is enabled; more episodes show more behavior and take longer.

episodes_per_update.description: Complete episodes collected under one frozen policy and critic before one PPO update; a final partial collection is also updated.

advantage_normalization.description: Policy advantage normalization: batch normalizes once over the combined rollout before PPO epochs; minibatch normalizes each shuffled optimizer slice in each epoch; none uses raw advantages. Separate from preference reward normalization.
